passage: The biologist Ynes Mexia did not begin collecting plants until she was fifty-five ______ over the next thirteen years, she gathered some 150,000 specimens across Mexico and South America, including about 500 species new to science.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: Both sides are complete sentences: “Mexia did not begin…fifty-five years old” and “over the next thirteen years, she gathered…”
Two independent clauses need a semicolon (or a period).
A comma alone makes a comma splice, nothing makes a run-on, and the comma inside “years, old” breaks a phrase.
key: Test whether both sides could stand alone; if so, use a semicolon.
